rules.name: Minimum Income Floor
rules.explanation: Monthly income must be at least ₹20,000. Below this is a hard reject with no score override.

rules.name: DTI Hard Ceiling
rules.explanation: EMI obligations above 60% of income breach the hard debt-to-income ceiling.

rules.name: No Overdrawn Balance
rules.explanation: A negative running balance signals overdraft / cheque bounce risk, hard reject.

rules.name: Healthy Income Band
rules.explanation: Monthly income of ₹35,000+ indicates comfortable repayment capacity.

rules.name: Premium Income Band
rules.explanation: Monthly income of ₹50,000+ adds further repayment headroom.

rules.name: EMI Ratio Acceptable
rules.explanation: EMI obligations within 50% of income (the preferred DTI band).

rules.name: EMI Ratio Strong
rules.explanation: EMI obligations within 30% of income leave a large repayment buffer.

rules.name: Limited Active EMIs
rules.explanation: At most one existing EMI obligation detected in the statement.

rules.name: Positive Residual Balance
rules.explanation: Average end-of-period balance above ₹5,000 shows a cash buffer.

rules.name: Strong Residual Balance
rules.explanation: Average balance above ₹25,000 indicates consistent surplus.

rules.name: Salary Regularity
rules.explanation: Recognisable salary credit(s) present, a stable, verifiable income source.

rules.name: Low Income Volatility
rules.explanation: Month-on-month income varies by 30% or less (coefficient of variation).

rules.name: Salaried Income Type
rules.explanation: Income is salaried rather than variable / self-employed.

rules.name: Adequate Savings Ratio
rules.explanation: At least 20% of inflows are retained after outflows.

rules.name: Sufficient Transaction Volume
rules.explanation: Enough transactions to derive a meaningful cash-flow picture.

rules.name: Credit Activity Present
rules.explanation: At least one credit (inflow) observed in the period.

rules.name: Substantial Inflow Volume
rules.explanation: Total inflows over the period exceed ₹1,00,000.

rules.name: Above Comfort Income
rules.explanation: Monthly income comfortably clears the ₹25,000 comfort threshold.

rules.name: Self-Employment Flag
rules.explanation: Variable / self-employed income routes the file to manual review.

rules.name: Volatility Review Flag
rules.explanation: Income volatility above 40% routes the file to manual review.

rules.name: Multiple EMI Flag
rules.explanation: More than two active EMIs routes the file to manual review.

rules.name: Thin Income Flag
rules.explanation: Income below ₹18,000 routes the file to manual review.

rules.name: Low Buffer Flag
rules.explanation: A near-zero average balance routes the file to manual review.

rules.name: Income Source Flag
rules.explanation: Absence of any salary credit routes the file to manual review.
